title: drain_once scans dead/ dir on every drain pass to count entries
description: drain_once does a full O(dead_count) directory scan of dead/ on every invocation just to set a gauge. With large dead-letter accumulation (operator ignoring dead/) this is unnecessary I/O every retry_interval. A cheaper design: maintain the count as an AtomicU64 incremented on each dead-letter write, decremented when the operator removes files. Alternatively, scan only at startup and on dead-letter moves. At scale (thousands of dead-letter files) the current scan adds latency to every drain cycle.
